pass_results.name: graph_capture
pass_results.reason: streams ['action', 'video'] outlive a control cycle, so their extent grows and per-cycle shapes change, so a captured graph is invalidated every cycle and recapture costs more than replay saves (measured 1.43x SLOWER on LingBot-VA)

pass_results.name: engine_offload
pass_results.reason: precision='native': FP8 engine is not authorized; H100 explicit E4M3 projections with native processing and schedule; task quality unverified on this device

pass_results.name: fsdp_elision
pass_results.reason: world_size=1, so every FSDP all-gather is identity while still paying a flat-param copy and stream sync per unit per forward

pass_results.name: allocator_churn_elision
pass_results.reason: closed-loop serving has a stable working set, so releasing the pool between control steps only forces re-allocation next step

pass_results.name: debug_dump_elision
pass_results.reason: per-chunk tensor dumps do a synchronous D2H on the critical path and are not consumed by the serving client

pass_results.name: obs_decode_elision
pass_results.reason: caller wants actions only; ['vae.decoder'] need never be resident or executed

pass_results.name: conditioning_prefill
pass_results.reason: ['text_kv', 'negative_text_kv'] declared pure in ['episode'] scope, but recomputed on all 8 forwards per control step (kv_refresh=2 + video=2 + action=4)

pass_results.name: prompt_encoder_staging
pass_results.reason: no memory pressure on this device class (sm_90, 79 GiB): keeping the prompt encoder resident avoids per-reset PCIe moves and allocator churn

pass_results.name: ring_kv_addressing
pass_results.reason: streams ['video', 'action'] live across control steps in a pool that is currently addressed by boolean mask, costing a host sync and a full-pool copy per layer per forward

pass_results.name: action_terminal_forward_elision
pass_results.reason: the action phase's terminal forward writes provisional K/V that clear_pred_cache drops before any forward reads it; its output is discarded by construction
